development_cohort: 217 assembly-QC-passing Moller hosts used in prior Phase 2
validation_cohort: 36 hosts excluded from development solely by missing/failed assembly QC

outcome_blind_amendments.reason: pilot reassembly QC showed that whole-genome fragmentation can persist despite recoverable full-length target genes; eligibility was therefore changed before any recovery outcome access to a targeted feature-completeness gate
two excessive-depth assemblies exhausted the fixed WSL memory ceiling; deterministic read-ID downsampling was frozen as a technical retry before any recovery outcome access

assembly_recovery_policy.retry_trigger: incomplete or failed assembly after checksum-verified full-read attempt
assembly_recovery_policy.retry_sampling: deterministic BLAKE2b read-ID Bernoulli sampling, mate synchronized

target: p0017 strict susceptible (S) versus strict resistant (R); intermediate excluded

primary_predictor.name: WTA glycosylation receptor rule
primary_predictor.positive_if: tarS intact AND tarM not intact AND tarP not intact
primary_predictor.rationale: frozen post-hoc mechanistic hypothesis from the development cohort

primary_feature_eligibility.note: targeted feature-completeness gate fixed before recovery outcomes; no phenotype participates

strict_subgroup_eligibility: development whole-assembly gates after >=500-bp reporting floor: 2.5-3.2 Mbp, <=500 contigs, N50 >=10 kb, ambiguous bases <=1%

bootstrap.resampling_unit: reported clonal complex with all member hosts retained

analysis_rule: one evaluation only; no model or threshold changes after outcomes are joined
interpretation: A pass is internal outcome-blind recovery validation, not external or clinical validation. A fail remains a fail and cannot be repaired by retuning on this cohort.
